cards.name: Green-screen finish: key, despill, edge, then grade-match
cards.summary: The full order for a real green-screen plate: key the screen, clean and choke the matte edge, remove the green spill, then match the foreground's colour and level to the background plate (light wrap and grain last).
use_for: presenter or interview shot on green into a news set or graphic background
product or object shots on green
avoid: despilling before the key is pulled (the keyer then sees less green)
choking hard to hide spill instead of suppressing it (fingers and hair vanish)
a perfect-looking key that ignores the plate: unmatched black level and colour give the cut-out away
cards.keyframes_note: Order: (1) keyer, (2) matte clean-up (Key Cleaner, then a light Matte Choker), (3) spill suppression, (4) grade match to the background (5) light wrap and matching grain. After Effects stack: Keylight with Screen Colour sampled from the real screen (#00B140 is only nominal chroma green), Clip Black/White to solidify the matte while viewing Screen Matte (View 5), then Final Result (View 11); Key Cleaner recovers edge detail; Advanced Spill Suppressor Method 1 (Standard) after the key; Matte Choker 20 with 3 px softness is a light tighten (its default Choke 75 is heavy). Premiere: Ultra Key does key, clean-up and spill in one effect (Setting 0 = Default; then Pedestal/Choke/Soften and the Spill group), then Lumetri Color for the match (Temperature, Tint, Exposure, Saturation start neutral: set them by eye on the scopes against the plate; they are placeholders here). The spec builds the Premiere half on a placeholder plate (greenscreen/presenter.mp4) over clip_b; its AE half carries only Keylight and Advanced Spill Suppressor because one spec entry pairs one AE effect with one Premiere effect: build the full AE stack from 'after_effects'. Light wrap has no native effect: 'Light wrap (built from layers)'. Measured 2026-10-13 on the synthetic green plate (make_test_media.py: a disc drifting over #00B140): both apps key it cleanly; a real plate with hair and motion blur is still untested.
built_from: Compositing finish order: key, despill, edge, grade-match

verified.note: Ultra Key removes the #00B140 screen completely and the disc sits cleanly on the background plate with no green fringe; the grade match and light wrap cannot be judged on synthetic plates.

ae.note: Keylight with the full four-effect stack (and the spec's two-effect pair) keys the screen out cleanly; the disc reads a little more muted than Premiere's (mean |luma| difference 6.9-10.8).
